content.question: Can I finance my Maxima project with no payments for 90 days?
content.answer: Yes. Maxima Concrete homeowners in Central Ohio can finance patios, pool decks and outdoor living projects through Lyon Financial and make no payments for the first 90 days after the loan is funded. Amounts go up to $250,000 with terms up to 30 years. Interest accrues from the date of funding, and approval is subject to credit.

content.text: Lyon Financial has been helping homeowners finance pools, patios, pergolas, landscaping and complete backyard builds for more than four decades — with higher amounts and some of the longest terms available.

items.question: What does "no payments for 90 days" mean?
items.answer: Your first payment isn't due until 90 days after your loan is funded. You can get your project built and start enjoying it before making a single payment.

items.question: Does interest accrue during the 90 days?
items.answer: Yes. Interest accrues from the date of funding, including during the 90-day deferral period. Rates and terms vary based on your qualifications and lender requirements.

items.question: What projects can I finance with Lyon?
items.answer: Patios, pool decks, walkways, outdoor living spaces and complete backyard projects built by Maxima Concrete — with amounts up to $250,000 and terms up to 30 years. Ask us whether your project qualifies.

items.question: How do I apply?
items.answer: Start with a free estimate from Maxima, then complete Lyon Financial's secure online application using the Apply with Lyon button on this page. Approval is subject to credit.

items.question: Is Lyon Financial the lender?
items.answer: No. Lyon Financial is not a lender — it connects you with lending partners. Rates and terms vary based on your qualifications and lender requirements.

items.question: Is Lyon my only financing option?
items.answer: No. Maxima also works with Hearth, a quick option for most concrete work. You can compare both on our financing page and choose the offer that fits your budget.
